app_name: NER Smart Logistics & Accessibility Intelligence Platform (NE-LOGIX)

layouts.container: max-w-[1600px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6
layouts.header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/90 border-b border-white/10

accessibility.min_contrast: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text
accessibility.aria_labels: MANDATORY on all interactive icon buttons and toggles
accessibility.data_testid: Required on all buttons, filters, inputs, metrics, and cards

media.image_handling: Object cover with subtle dark gradient scrims

3d_libraries.map_engine: Leaflet.js with custom glowing route polylines and animated markers
3d_libraries.chart_engine: Recharts for real-time risk spike graphs and XGBoost calibration accuracy curves

image_urls.description: Mountain highway landscape in North East India
Colorful goods carrier truck in mountain terrain

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement NE-LOGIX (North East Region Smart Logistics & Accessibility Intelligence Platform) with a React frontend, Leaflet live map with live vehicles and risk corridors, rule-based disruption scoring + synthetic XGBoost calibration panel, field reporting modal with offline/synced state and image preview, English/Assamese multilingual toggle, role/state/payload/status filtering, and active alert simulation triggers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT use complete transparent background in header or overlays.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not use Inter as heading font.
Use Generous Spacing Philosophy (p-6, p-8, gap-6).
Ensure high contrast on hover states.
